title: INSTRUMENT PANEL WIRING HARNESS
summary: Routing of the instrument panel (dash) wiring harness behind the gauge cluster and down to the console area: connections to gauges, clock, wiper switch/solenoid/relay, heater controls, cigar lighter, neutral safety switch, back-up lamp switch, park brake alarm switch and RH door jamb switch. Indicator/illumination bulbs plug into the cluster; two harness clips are riveted to the panel/console structure with blind rivets, and the radio lead is taped to the harness.

parts.name: BULB
parts.name_expanded: Bulb – cluster illumination, headlamp, clock and door ajar indicator (callouts 1A–1D)

parts.name: CLIP
parts.name_expanded: Clip – harness, near park brake alarm switch

parts.name: CLIP
parts.name_expanded: Clip – harness, near cigar lighter reflector

fastening.to: panel below the cigar lighter reflector
fastening.note: Rivet [2] goes through clip [5] into the panel; clip located 2.36 and 3.00 from reference edges.

fastening.to: console/panel bracket near park brake alarm switch
fastening.note: Rivet [2] goes through clip [3] into a .192/.199 dia hole drilled at the existing dimple (2.22 REF, .080 REF); an existing hole is also shown at the bracket.
Callout 6E: tape [6] wraps the radio lead (6 in.) to the harness assembly.
Bulbs [1] plug into the harness sockets at the cluster: 1A cluster illumination (two places), 1B headlamps, 1C clock, 1D door ajar.
Bulb [4] plugs into the heater control lead socket.
